purpose: Measure the incremental effect of current-request coach method selection and explicit author handoff, using the existing native RSI/SE8 driver

authorization.user_scope: User authorized local source implementation and same-model comparison; no deployment, publication, or online workspace changes
authorization.limit_status: Remaining conservative allowance under the same 10 CNY activity cap after aborted build pilot; retained reservation is not a known actual bill
authorization.limit_origin: Internal batch cap, not an explicit monetary request from user
authorization.pricing: Reuse EX13 peak upper estimate and worst-case request reservation; record actual usage and returned model names

model.limits: Preserve production per-request limits in both arms; do not restore the old universal 16K override
model.served_model: Record actual provider response name on every call; alias identity is not an immutable backend-version claim

limits.retry_policy: No replacement of generation failures; pilot is retained separately and does not count as a heldout result

arms.A: Frozen experiment-only replacement at the same first-valid-prepare entry: original execute_coach planning prompt/schema with stage_start semantics, projected into the common handoff with methods=[]; no method-selection instructions added
arms.B: Current-request presentation coach at first valid prepare: purpose, learning_goal, reading_path, methods(method_id, revision, adaptation), needs_read and reason; main author receives the common handoff and reads selected methods
arms.common: Same candidate-inclusive method catalog and assets, author prompt and tools, prepare entry, one coach call per turn, within-turn reuse, author model and limits; observing fixture in both arms, no active Tutor review loop

catalog.source: ../common-source/skills/presentation/methods/catalog.json; revision 6, chart-reveal@3 available identically in A and B; formal catalog stays revision 5
catalog.candidate_status: Isolated experiment only; formal adoption and online catalog are unchanged
catalog.selection: Coach may select appropriate existing methods or justify none; no task fixture seeds a method ID or method_refs

pilot.purpose: Check actual coach-to-author linkage and full method input before spending on heldout pages; separate topic and input from both evaluation tasks
pilot.gate: Inspect coach input/output, selected methods, returned read bodies visible in a later author request, matching refs and first delivery. A read declaration alone is insufficient. If linkage fails, stop main batch and repair the identified flow offline; retain spent pilot and cost

isolation.source: ../source-freeze.json; common-source plus variants/presentation-A.rs and presentation-B.rs; only arm difference is crates/runtime/src/tutor_coach/presentation.rs; sequential binaries are recorded in ../logs/build-A-record.json and build-B-record.json; recovery uses author-B-fixed.exe, validated by ../pair-verification.json; original identical B binary is excluded
isolation.author_input: Identical task prompt within each pair; no evaluator-only notes, pilot output, old page feedback, or method IDs seeded by fixtures
isolation.task_exposure: Implementation agents do not receive heldout prompts or oracle. Root and the experiment custodian may inspect. Reviewers receive task prompt and oracle after generation, not arm identity or implementation findings
isolation.history: Fresh native memory/history/temp per run; no import of base presentation or previous conversation
isolation.coach: First valid prepare uses current request in both arms. Actual user request, author proposal, read-source evidence, prior coach guidance and catalog remain distinguishable inputs. One call per turn, repeated prepare reuses the same advice
isolation.teaching_review: Observing fixture remains; this evaluates author planning and first delivery, not active continuous teaching-review efficacy
isolation.production: No deployment or writes to production workspace
isolation.reader: render-source/manifest.json; seven Reader files frozen before any paid run, used identically for all pages

outcomes.primary: First successful delivery within the initial user turn, allowing ordinary author self-preview and patch
outcomes.linkage: Separate coach recommendation, author read request, successful nonempty returned content, that content entering a subsequent author request, declared refs, and actual adaptation seen in page; do not collapse them into a single usage flag
outcomes.also_archive: First write; all public native and provider I/O; coach input/output and common handoff; timing/call count; method read files and body visibility; first and final delivered versions; failed or incomplete runs; usage and cost
outcomes.coach_record: Extract structured request purpose=tutor_presentation_plan and same-number response. Selected InstructionModule resident-agent.presentation.coach@coach-handoff.v1 appends the actual presentation_coach.v1 definition in sampling_guidance.v1 within ordered_messages; existing guidance ledger avoids repeat append and re-emits after compaction. An asset manifest entry alone is not handoff evidence. Parse JSON with trailing whitespace. Prepare receipts remain status-only. No additional native artifact; missing purpose attribution remains unknown rather than zero
outcomes.evaluation: Read full page and operate its real UI against independent oracle. Mechanism task: shared identity, path contributions and forward/backward states. Derivation task: uninterrupted valid derivation, global-minimum and degeneracy reasoning, graph/numbers/text consistency. No universal first-screen chart or short-video requirement
outcomes.decision: Observed read/adaptation is necessary evidence of mechanism but not proof of page quality. Compare correctness, reading path and useful interaction; retain failures and counterexamples. Two repeats per topic yield directional evidence, not statistical or learner-outcome proof

validation.known_unrelated_failure: source_presentation_tool_spec_exposes_quote_or_media_target still expects two input alternatives while the pre-change music schema has three. Its expectation and the schema exist in original-source; not modified in this task. Full first run in presentation-final-tests.log.

recovery.reason: First A/B binaries were identical because copy2 retained mtime and Cargo treated B as fresh; pilot stopped before any heldout run. B rebuilt with fresh compiler work and pair verification.
recovery.prior_cost_interpretation: Conservative peak-price accounting includes the second interrupted connection full reservation; actual provider charge for that call is unknown. Do not present retained reservation as an actual bill.
recovery.unchanged: Source content, model, tasks, pilot, main order, method library and Reader remain frozen; only the corrected B build artifact replaces the invalid B executable.
